name: planning-flow-quick
description: A quick plan for a small coding change — one short plan file with one ticket, the repository's patterns and the tests to extend found by two scoped explorers instead of a full codebase map, unknowns checked on the spot, only the user's decisions asked, one fresh check of the plan, and a warning whenever the change outgrows a quick plan, recommending the full planning-flow skill when it is installed.
